CISO.index_note: Means use clean (status ok) hours only; imputed and flagged hours excluded. annual lists local calendar years with at least 2,000 clean hours (2025 is partial: to 2025-08-26).
CISO.tz: local hour; month_hour index = (month-1)*24 + hour; how index = dow*24 + hour (0 = Monday)
